newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Shell Coal appoints Bob Scharp CEO.
newsitem.headline: Shell Coal appoints Bob Scharp CEO.

text.p: Shell Coal Pty Ltd (SCPL), a subsidiary of the Royal Dutch-Shell Group, said on Friday it had appointed former Kerr McGee Corp executive Robert Scharp as chief executive officer.

"Bob Scharp brings to the position a wealth of experience from 22 years in the coal industry ranging from mine inception through to operations in both open cut and underground mines," Shell Coal chairman Walter van de Vijver said in a statement.

The Royal Dutch-Shell Group in April consolidated its global coal into the new wholly-owned international company Shell Coal, which has interests in Venezeula and South Africa, and is Australia's third biggest coal producer.
"SCPL is an international company with global aspirations and is in a strong position to participate in the expanding hard coal market and in power generation," the statement said.
Scharp was Kerr-McGee's senior vice president, oil and gas production operations from 1995 to 19997, having previously been president of the Kerr-McGee Coal Corporation, it said.
